name: Artificial Adaptive Intelligence

lineage.emergence_condition: Sufficient adaptive feedback loops within bounded operational domain

transition_threshold.to_agi: Demonstrate unsupervised cross-domain transfer on ≥3 novel domains without retraining

role_enums.label: Pattern Recognizer
role_enums.description: Identifies recurring structures and signals in high-dimensional input spaces.

role_enums.label: Domain Adapter
role_enums.description: Modifies internal representations to conform to shifting domain distributions.

role_enums.label: Contextual Reasoner
role_enums.description: Derives situational inferences from locally available context.

role_enums.label: Feedback Integrator
role_enums.description: Absorbs environmental reward and corrective signals to update behavior.

role_enums.label: Task Specialist
role_enums.description: Achieves high proficiency within a designated task category.

role_enums.label: Anomaly Detector
role_enums.description: Flags deviations from learned distributional norms.

role_enums.label: Signal Classifier
role_enums.description: Assigns categorical labels to input signals based on learned feature maps.

role_enums.label: Policy Executor
role_enums.description: Enacts learned behavioral policies in response to environmental states.

analyzer_layers.name: Perceptual Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Raw input ingestion, normalization, and feature extraction from multimodal streams.

analyzer_layers.name: Pattern Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Statistical clustering, correlation mapping, and recurring-sequence identification.

analyzer_layers.name: Contextual Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Situational grounding that anchors pattern outputs to domain-specific context windows.

analyzer_layers.name: Adaptive Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Online learning and policy adjustment from feedback signals and distributional drift.

analyzer_layers.name: Output Layer
analyzer_layers.description: Decision rendering, action selection, and response synthesis.

operators.description: Convert raw inputs to vector representations.
Pull relevant features from raw data.
Segment inputs into discrete processable units.
Apply learned importance scores to inferences.
Choose optimal action from policy space.
Dispatch action or signal to environment.
Record decisions and state for audit trail.

capabilities: High-accuracy pattern recognition within bounded domains
Online adaptation to distributional shift without full retraining

axis_alpha.label: Perception–Representation
axis_alpha.role: Maps raw inputs to internal symbolic representations.

axis_beta.label: Adaptation–Learning
axis_beta.role: Adjusts representations based on feedback within domain.

axis_gamma.label: Generalization–Transfer
axis_gamma.role: Extends learned knowledge to novel domains.
